pins.name: VDD
pins.notes: Pin 1. Needs 5 V for the fan: use VIN

pins.name: SDA
pins.notes: Pin 3. Add a pull-up to 3.3 V

pins.name: SCL
pins.notes: Pin 4. Add a pull-up to 3.3 V

pins.name: SEL
pins.notes: Pin 5. Connect to GND for I2C

sources.title: Sensirion SEN5x datasheet
sources.section: Pin 1 VDD 5 V, 2 GND, 3 SDA, 4 SCL, 5 SEL, 6 NC; I2C address 0x69, 100 kHz

sources.title: Sensirion SEN5x datasheet
sources.section: I2C lines are 3.3 V level; VOC and NOx are index values, not ppm
